source.description:
## Context

The border-label hint is cramped; discoverability is low once binds multiply.

## What to build

- `?` → swap the preview pane content to a binds cheatsheet (all current keys), `?` again to restore.
- Generate the cheatsheet from a single source of truth (a `docs/keys.md` or an env-driven table) so it never drifts from actual binds.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `?` toggles a cheatsheet in the preview area.
- [ ] Cheatsheet reflects all implemented binds (auto-derived, not hand-maintained).
- [ ] No key collisions with existing binds.
- [ ] README updated.

## Approach notes

- Land after the control-surface binds (t4/t5/t6/t7/t9/t10/t11/t12) are finalized so the cheatsheet is accurate.
- Layer: shell.
source.title: Help overlay: ? swaps preview pane to a binds cheatsheet
